rules.description: A GPU or large compute size is selected, which is significantly more expensive than general-purpose lab sizes.
rules.guidance: Confirm the lab genuinely needs GPU or large compute. Prefer a smaller size where possible. Estimate cost with the official pricing calculator.

rules.description: A public IPv4 address is requested, which incurs an hourly charge on both providers.
rules.guidance: Only enable a public IP when inbound access is required. Remove it for private-only labs.

rules.description: Premium/SSD storage is selected where standard storage may suffice for a lab.
rules.guidance: Use standard or balanced storage tiers for labs unless performance testing is an outcome.

rules.description: Multiple compute instances multiply the per-hour cost for the lab duration.
rules.guidance: Confirm each instance is required by a learner or technical task. Reduce the count where possible.

rules.description: A long expected lab duration increases total consumption cost.
rules.guidance: Ensure cleanup is configured so resources do not persist beyond the lab. Consider auto-shutdown where supported.
